next.reason: 1985: in the Report Section LINE-COUNTER only in a SOURCE clause; in the Procedure Division in any context of an integral-value data item; 'only the report writer control system can change the content of LINE-COUNTER'. §2023:8.4.3.15.3 SR1 states the first two ('may be referenced only in a SOURCE clause'; 'in any context where an integer data item may appear') and §2023:8.4.3.15.3 SR3 the third ('LINE-COUNTER shall not be referenced as a receiving operand'). Same compile-time refusals. 13.15.3 SR16 concerns PRESENT WHEN, new syntax.
